content: Vikram Patel informed Rohan Deshmukh that his health policy expired yesterday and offered a 1-year renewal at the same rate. Rohan confirmed that outpatient specialist coverage is included, inquired about the premium ($1,250), and requested a payment link. Vikram provided the secure payment link and renewal form, and Rohan confirmed he will sign and complete the payment by Friday.

action_items: Review and sign the renewal form
